data.name: Time Dungeons
data.detailed_description:
Time is breaking. The ancestors have been called.

When reality begins to fracture, four heroes are ripped from different eras and thrown into a war they were never meant to fight. To stop the timeline from collapsing, they must travel through dangerous time zones, recover powerful relics, and survive the endless hordes drawn to destroy them.

Time Dungeons is a 1-4 player co-op action tower defense roguelike where chaotic enemy swarms, powerful character builds, and strategic defense placement collide.

Fight through two distinct game modes:

Defend
Drop into a fractured era, protect the relic, build deadly defenses, level up your hero, and hold back overwhelming waves of enemies. Every run pushes your team harder, forcing you to upgrade, reposition, and adapt as the battlefield becomes complete chaos.

Survive
Forget the safety of the relic and dive into pure arcade roguelike survival. Explore, level up, stack powerful upgrades, and see how long you can last against never ending hordes. Chase high scores, climb the leaderboards, and push your build until the timeline finally breaks you.

Choose from 4 heroes, each with their own class identity and multiple specializations that dramatically change how they play. Build around abilities, towers, upgrades, rewards, and run progression to create new strategies every time you enter the dungeon.

Play solo or with up to 4 players online. Work together to restore the timeline through a quest driven campaign, or ignore destiny completely and chase leaderboard glory across endless runs.

Features

  • 1-4 player online co-op

  • Two core game modes: relic defense and arcade survival

  • Chaotic tower defense battles with massive enemy hordes

  • Roguelike upgrades, rewards, and run based progression

  • Multiple heroes, classes, and specializations

  • Build defenses, level up, and create powerful team strategies

  • Quest line focused on restoring the fractured timeline

  • Endless survival runs with leaderboards

  • Replayable missions across different time zones and eras

Can you hold the line, recover the relics, and stop time from collapsing forever?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 64Bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2500K or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX 1080 8GB or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64Bit
  • Processor: Any Above Minimum
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce RTX 2080 8GB or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
